newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to eliminate most quotas in IPO bids.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to eliminate most quotas in IPO bids.

text.p: Bangladesh Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria on Thursday proposed to scrap most quotas on subscriptions to initial public offerings (IPO) for 1997/98 fiscal year beginning on July 1.
He said "the (quota) should be withdrawn because of heavy demand from small investors for initial offers."
Kibria proposed to retain but at the same time to raise the quota for non-resident Bangladeshis to 10 percent from five percent.
Currently, foreign portfolio funds and different financial institutions get IPOs from reserved quotas.
